{{Quote|The winged xendrites have no natural predators on Xend. Instead, their population is controlled completely by the amount of available food. An increase (or decrease) in the insect population is immediately followed by a proportional change in the population of xendrites.|Holobrochure for the Tagge Holographic Museum of Chandrila|<ref name="Creatures" />}}
'''Xend''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Creatures" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Xend system/Legends|Xend system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to [[Insect/Legends|insects]] as well as the [[winged xendrite]], a type of [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] that typically hanged from [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Plant/Legends|branches]] and [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] insects. The creatures had no natural [[Diet/Legends|predators]], and their population was instead controlled by that of the available insects.<ref name="Creatures" />

Eventually, however, [[Limb/Legends|winged]] xendrites were exported to other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] as a form of [[Insecticide/Legends|insecticide]], only for them to overrun their new homes' ecologies. Xend was mentioned in an entry of a [[Holo-brochure|holobrochure]] for the [[Tagge Holographic Museum]] of<ref name="Creatures" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="CSWE Chandrila">{{CSWECite|I|119|Chandrila}}</ref> [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] dedicated to the creature.<ref name="Creatures" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xend was mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The section of the book mentioning the celestial body was authored by [[Chuck Truett]].<ref name="Creatures" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Xend [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Xend itself, in grid square M-8.<ref name="TEA" />
